description: Retrieves a past execution record by transaction ID, including status, latency and price. Authenticated callers can read their own retained inputs, outputs, provenance and error details. Without authentication, free-tier lookups return only redacted metadata: inputs, outputs, errors, provenance and the audit body are omitted. Paid transaction lookup requires authentication. Use this to inspect a previous strale_execute call or debug a failure.

transaction_id.description: Transaction ID returned from a strale_execute call

name: strale_transaction
title: Read a transaction record
